title: Committed Annual Spend and Room Tolerance Points — Commercial Credit Account
content:
In a room payment on a Commercial Credit Account, the annual spend committed on the customer's active Contract Pricing Agreement adds percentage points to **the tolerance percentage used**.

### Clause

The tolerance percentage used gains five percentage points for a customer whose active Contract Pricing Agreement commits at least two hundred fifty thousand dollars of annual spend, two percentage points for one whose active agreement commits at least twenty-five thousand dollars but less than that, and none otherwise.

### Points schedule

| Annual spend committed on the active agreement, USD | Points |
|---|---|
| 250000.00 or more | 5 |
| 25000.00 up to 249999.99 | 2 |
| below 25000.00, or no active agreement | 0 |

### Boundaries (hypothetical)

- A commitment of exactly 25000.00 earns 2 points; 24999.99 earns none.
- A commitment of exactly 250000.00 earns 5 points.
- An agreement in any status other than active earns no points.
